minutes.headline: Planning Board approved the Sunny Hill storm water permit but declined to release the Holman completion certificates and bonds.
minutes.summary: The board took public comment on an open space donation and on restoring the Pledge of Allegiance, then handled three storm water matters. It approved the 317-321 Sunny Hill permit with standard conditions, continued the 255 Sunny Hill hearing to March 11, and declined to issue completion certificates or release performance guarantees for 147 and 159 Holman. Discussion covered the draft battery energy storage bylaw, the water supply protection district rewrite and hearing timing, and committee reports.

attendees.role: staff filling in at the planning office

public_comment.topic: Asked how someone would offer an open space land donation; told the select board is the likely first contact.
Asked why the board no longer opens with the Pledge of Allegiance and asked the chair to restore it.
Opposed the 255 Sunny Hill project because the site is very wet; commented on repeated continuances.
Abutter asked for assurance the driveway will be built two feet below his driveway, and said town sewer drawings show wetlands differently from the plan.
Site owner clarified the Wednesday site walk is at 10:00 a.m. with the conservation agent.

budget_items.what_was_said: The applicant gave the cost of the storm water work for both lots and the board discussed performance guarantees against it.
Board members discussed the amount held for the two Holman houses and the cost of fixing the stone trench.
The storm water task force is working on what goes into an enterprise fund, with public outreach expected before a vote.
A member recounted select board discussion of expected state funds that did not arrive.

Staff to advertise the water supply protection district rewrite and battery storage bylaw for a March 25 hearing, with further discussion March 11.
Board members to confirm attendance at the March 6 Green Communities solar meeting so it can be posted by Monday.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted to approve the 317-321 Sunny Hill storm water permit with standard conditions and the previously set residential construction hours.
The board voted not to issue completion certificates for 147 and 159 Holman, and then not to release the performance guarantee for the two houses.
The board continued the 255 Sunny Hill Road storm water hearing to 6:05 p.m. on March 11, after an abutter and another speaker raised drainage and wetland concerns.
Staff will advertise the water supply protection district rewrite and the battery storage bylaw for a March 25 hearing, with further discussion on March 11.
The board heard that the storm water task force is working on an enterprise fund, with public outreach expected before any vote.

why_it_matters: Holding the Holman guarantee means the town keeps the money that secures the stone trench fix until the work is accepted, which protects the town rather than the developer.
The storm water enterprise fund, if it reaches a vote, would change how storm water work is paid for, and residents would be asked to vote on it after outreach.
The battery storage and water supply protection district bylaws are headed to a March 25 hearing, where residents can comment on land-use rules.
watch_next: March 11: the continued 255 Sunny Hill Road storm water hearing, at 6:05 p.m., and further discussion of the bylaws.
March 25: the planned public hearing on the water supply protection district rewrite and the battery storage bylaw.
